name: 90046 · Los Angeles, CA
findings: ZIP 90046 (Los Angeles) has 271 nonprofit organizations. 110 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 85 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (15% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 90046 (Los Angeles) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
27% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 90046 (Los Angeles) list civic or political action in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 45% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to take civic or political action now, including outside formal organizations?
